A week-long class from Mathcamp 2018 about the principal, Gaussian, and mean curvature of
potatoes embedded in $\mathbb{R}^3$.

The prerequisites are linear algebra --- in particular eigenvalues and eigenvectors --- and
multivariable calculus.
